summary: Barclays PLC furnished a Form 6-K covering an ordinary senior debt issuance: a Pricing Agreement dated October 29, 2026 with Barclays Capital Inc. for 5.674% fixed-to-floating senior callable notes due 2030, 5.918% notes due 2032 and 6.367% notes due 2037, plus a Twenty-Third Supplemental Indenture and global security forms. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine shelf takedown of bank senior unsecured debt under an existing US indenture framework. Watch only for final principal amounts and spread-to-Treasury pricing in the completed offering documents.
